text:
Mia - Growth: Quick kickoff for Community Launch week: need copy, routing, and the webinar plan for 'Starter Refapps' + 'Cost Labs'. Target: launch posts + 1 live run + email drip. Who wants which piece?
Sam - Marketing: I'll own the blog launch post and social calendar. Need a hero paragraph and 2 headline variants for A/B.
Alejandra - DevRel: I can build the tutorial repo and 25-minute lab. Recommend we include a tiny reproducible infra script (terraform or docker-compose).
Ravi - Content: For headlines, try these two: \"Ship a refapp in 30 minutes with Redwood\" and \"Real benchmarks: 3x token cost improvements, live\". Want short teasers for social too.
Mia - Growth: Great. I'll test subject lines across two segments. Proposed email subjects: (A) \"Ship a refapp in 30 minutes\" (B) \"See how we cut token cost 3x\". Also testing CTA text: \"Reserve a spot\" vs \"Get the tutorial\".
Nate - Growth Ops: Routing plan: refapp_signups -> self-serve onboarding flow + repo link. bench_signups -> nurture track + tag to SEs if company size >100. Implementation tasks: add hidden field utm_campaign=lab_launch, add tag mapping rule.
Kai - Product: For the Bench narrative, we'll include exact test matrix: model (Redwood-13B-quant), quantization (q4f16), hardware (A100 vs T4), batch sizes, and perf metrics: tokens/sec, median latency, tokens/$ (rounded). Also include reproducible config file.
Sam - Marketing: Copy drafts: blog hero: \"Community Labs: hands-on refapps and live cost labs to make inference predictable, fast, and affordable. Free 30-60m sessions.\" Social snippet: \"New: Community Labs — code-first workshops + live benchmark runs. Join free: https://go.redwood/labs?utm_source=social\"
Alejandra - DevRel: Repo naming: redwood/community-labs-starter. I'll include: 1) full tutorial, 2) minimal infra (docker + terraform optional), 3) a small sample dataset, 4) a pre-baked Dockerfile with quantized model.
Ravi - Content: Let's prepare two blog formats: long-form tutorial (1200-1500 words) and a short announcement (250-400 words) for HN/Dev.to. Different CTAs: tutorial -> repo, announcement -> webinar sign-up.
Mia - Growth: Email flow: 3 messages. Day0: welcome + repo link. Day3: bench highlights + invite to live run. Day7: nudge + replay. Add a 1-question NPS after the session.
Nate - Growth Ops: I'll set up routing rules in HubSpot: property mapping: source_medium, utm_campaign, campaign_variant. Tagging rules: if team_size >=50 and qps_estimate > 50000 -> tag enterprise_demo and notify SE slack channel.
Sam - Marketing: Social creative matrix: platform x creative. Example: Twitter: short hook + 1-line stat + link. LinkedIn: longer post + CTA form. HN: show HN for refapp repo with minimal friction.
Alejandra - DevRel: For the workshop format: 25m live walkthrough, 20m hands-on (people follow repo), 15m Q&A. Provide a timestamped agenda on the landing page and a 'what you need' checklist.
Ravi - Content: Draft copy snippets for social (variant A/B): \nA: \":rocket: Build a refapp in 30m with Redwood Community Labs — code + walkthrough + live Q&A: https://go.redwood/labs?a=refapp\"\nB: \":chart_with_downwards_trend: Real runs: see how batching + quantization reduced token costs 3x. Join our live bench: https://go.redwood/labs?b=bench\"
Mia - Growth: Use emojis selectively. Track content variant via utm_content param. Example: ?utm_campaign=lab_launch&utm_content=postA
Kai - Product: I'll provide a 1-line Eng quote for social: \"We're focused on predictable inference economics — batch smarter, cache prefixes, and pick kernels that match the model.\" Also attaching benchmark config (will push to the repo).
Nate - Growth Ops: Reminder: enable retargeting pixel on landing and create custom audience for visitors who hit /labs/repo. I'll build the mapping and share docs.
campaign-bot: Reminder set: planning sync in 36 hours.
Mia - Growth: Owners + deadlines: Sam -> blog post + social calendar (48h), Alejandra -> repo + starter infra (72h), Ravi -> copy pack + HN post (48h), Nate -> tracking & routing rules (24h), Kai -> benchmark artifacts + Eng quote (48h). I'll compile variants and set A/B tests.
Sam - Marketing: Perfect. I'll create the launch Trello and PR templates. Link to draft landing: https://go.redwood/marketing/labs-draft. Please add comments on copy by EOD. Thanks all :tada:
